title: Sequence projection and normalized whole-system Hom correspondence
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and a finite-type $k$-scheme $W$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. On a fixed small skeleton $\mathcal V=W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ set $B_n=(R/t^n)_W$ for $n\ge1$ and $A=\lim_nB_n$. Let $\mathcal T$ be the ringed sequence site with ring $B=(B_n)_n$, and let $\mathscr S_W=\operatorname{Mod}_{\mathcal T}(B)$ be its strict quotient-semilinear module systems [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories and cochain shifts, with $d_{K[r]}=(-1)^r d_K$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix a supplied coefficient calculus $S$ with its coherence data, reduction $\mathcal R$ and total limit $\mathcal L=R\lim D(U)$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]; $U$ is termwise scalar restriction along $A\to B_n$.

There is a canonical ringed projection $p:(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal T),B)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal V),A)$ [def-pur-ringed-topos-morphism-of-universes], with underlying constant-system inverse image $c$ and structural map $cA\to B$ given by the quotient projections. It factors as $p=g\circ a$ through $(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal T),cA)$, where $a$ has identity underlying geometric morphism, $a_*=U$ is exact, and $g_*=\lim$. Its ordinary module adjunction is
$$p^*Q=(Q\otimes_A B_n)_n,\qquad p_*M=\lim UM.$$
For $h:Q\to\lim UM$ its adjunct has components $f_n(x\otimes b)=b\pi_nh(x)$, where $\pi_n$ is the limit projection; conversely $f$ has transpose $x\mapsto(f_n(x\otimes1))_n$. These inverse correspondences are natural sheaf-module correspondences, including the quotient transitions.

Let $\alpha:Lp^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R$ be the canonical comparison of universal left-derived functors, normalized on flat-term K-flat representatives by the same strict quotient tensor complex [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Let $\kappa:Rp_*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L$ be the canonical composition comparison for $p=g\circ a$, normalized on every K-injective $B$-complex $I$ and every K-injective replacement $j:UI\to J$ by the class of $\lim j$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Then $\alpha,\kappa$ identify the canonical derived adjunction $Lp^*\dashv Rp_*$ with the specified adjunction $\mathcal R\dashv\mathcal L$ of $S$, on the entire derived system Hom sets. Explicitly, for every flat-term K-flat complex $Q$, K-injective $B$-complex $I$, chain map $f:p^*Q\to I$ and replacement $j:UI\to J$, its transpose under this identification is represented by
$$Q\xrightarrow{\operatorname{adj}_0(f)}\lim UI\xrightarrow{\lim j}\lim J,$$
where $\operatorname{adj}_0(f)$ is the ordinary transpose just specified. The unit and counit of $S$ are the identity transposes for precisely this derived Hom correspondence. The correspondence is natural in all derived inputs and independent of resolution choices. Equality on evaluated Hom sets is not a hypothesis.
